title: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. (CVE-2026-84443)
description: LibreOffice Base documents could bind macros to document events such as opening or closing the document. Due to a flaw, these macros would run without respect to the macro security settings, potentially allowing execution of arbitrary commands when opening or converting a crafted database document. This behavior has been corrected in fixed versions where macros bound to Base document events now adhere to the macro security settings like macros in other document types.
